skills.name: Scythe
skills.description:
Julian hurls a flying scythe in the target direction, dealing 380<font color='#27C0C7'>( +140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.
The scythe disappears upon hitting a non-minion enemy.

skills.name: Sword
skills.description: Julian summons a flying sword and dashes in the target direction, dealing 400<font color='#27C0C7'>( +80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies along the way.

skills.name: Chain
skills.description: Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 300<font color='#27C0C7'>( +100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies hit after a short delay and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

skills.name: Smith's Legacy
skills.description:
After casting two different skills, Julian enhances his third skill. Casting the enhanced skill makes all his skills go on a 9-6s Cooldown (decreases with his level), but his Basic Attacks within the next 5s will deal 75<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and pull the target toward him.
Julian gains 15% extra Hybrid Lifesteal for 5s each time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).

items.name: Clock of Destiny
items.des: Unique Passive - Time: Gains 20 extra Max HP and 4 extra Magic Power every 20s, capped at 15 stacks.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.

items.name: Brute Force Breastplate
items.des: Unique Passive - Brute Force: Each second after dealing damage, gain 6 extra Physical Attack and Magic Power and 2% extra Movement Speed for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Gain 15% extra Control Duration Reduction at full stacks.

items.name: Starlium Scythe
items.des: Unique Passive - Crisis: Within 3s after casting a skill, the caster's next Basic Attack will deal additional True Damage equal to 100 plus 100% Magic Power and briefly grant 10% Movement Speed. This effect has a 1.5s cooldown.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.
